purpose: Teach: 殴ら/混沌/露骨/濫用/在留/誘発/解任/権益

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時下に殴られた人々の証言を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper addressed testimonies from people who were beaten during wartime, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly. Open-ended — inviting her to expand or correct. Teacher-to-student but as peers in intellectual territory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、革命期の混沌とした社会を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on how the social chaos during that revolutionary period created the conditions for that violence.
lines.style: Thoughtful, building as she speaks. Slight hesitation at the start, then confidence. She's checking her own framing as she answers, but not doubtfully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 露骨な人種差別の事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined explicit racial discrimination cases in another one, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, slightly more weight on the question. Not challenging — drawing out her thinking. A teacher recognizing a pattern in a student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、権力の濫用の事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I was looking at how that discrimination functioned as a mechanism of power consolidation.
lines.style: Clearer now, more assured. She's finding her ground. Speaks with the precision of someone who has thought this through deeply, not performed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 在留外国人の権利問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your work on resident foreigners' rights issues — that was another thread, wasn't it?
lines.style: Attentive, connecting the dots aloud with her. Warm but professional. The quality of a teacher who actually remembers what a student wrote.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、災害が誘発する社会問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I was examining how large-scale disasters expose and worsen existing social fractures.
lines.style: Steady and clear. She's found her voice now. Speaking with quiet authority about her own research. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大臣解任の歴史的経緯を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the historical context around ministerial dismissals — that appeared in your work too?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower pace. Not testing her — marveling at the breadth. A teacher recognizing ambition and coherence in a student's arc.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、海洋権益の国際紛争を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I traced how maritime territorial disputes intersect with international law and nationalist politics.
lines.style: Confident close. Final answer carries weight. She's demonstrating mastery, not showing off. Slight settling into the chair — she's made her point.
